Production experience taking titles from GDD through Play Store release. Most recently owned the entire Unity client of a 3D character-driven mobile product, building its behaviour, animation, rendering and tooling systems end-to-end.
profile.summary_kreo: Software developer with production experience across mobile and web applications, working in C#, C/C++, Java, Python and JavaScript. bullets_gamedev: Took over sole ownership of the Unity client for a 3D companion product after the other Unity developers departed, delivering all gameplay, animation, rendering and tooling work through to a near-release build.

Built a data-driven behaviour system: 27 ScriptableObject behaviours selected from live context by requirement matching and a priority ladder, with recency-weighted random selection so ambient behaviour reads as spontaneous, not looping.

Implemented a 20-step execution interpreter composing performances from reusable steps - anchor navigation, animation playback, gesture-scrubbed clips, rig displacement, camera control - so new behaviours could be authored in the Inspector without code, alongside 11 custom editor tools.

Solved animations authored flush against furniture by displacing the collider-free visual rig to an interaction anchor while the physics body held its legal position; refactored movement onto a single-writer motor, fixing a Rigidbody/transform desync causing drift.

Built state-driven animation variant swapping, spring-bone secondary motion and a frame-accurate audio cue system locked to the animator playhead; shipped three URP quality tiers with automatic device-tier detection and a zero-allocation CPU/GPU profiling overlay.
bullets_kreo: Assumed sole responsibility for the Unity client of a production lifestyle application after the other Unity developers departed, independently owning all client-side development through to a near-release build.

Designed and documented the bi-directional message contract between the Unity runtime and the React Native host, adding an acknowledgement protocol that made a silently-failing interop layer diagnosable and a two-phase handshake that removed a startup deadlock between the runtimes.
Developed native platform plugins in Objective-C (iOS) and Java/JNI (Android) to reach device capabilities unavailable to the engine, with tiered degradation across hardware capability levels.
Built a data-driven architecture in which application behaviour is defined as editable configuration and interpreted at runtime, allowing new features to be authored without code changes.

Diagnosed a cross-runtime performance issue through on-device CPU and GPU profiling, establishing the engine consumed 6-11 ms against a 33 ms frame budget and redirecting investigation to main-thread contention.

projects.name: Chalo Yaar!

subtitle.itch: A cozy 3D travel simulator about road trips, exploration, photography, and vanlife.

projects.hero_tagline: The roadtrip you and your friends always talked about.
projects.multiplayer: Server-based networked multiplayer (itch); Netcode for GameObjects (resume)

download.note: itch download URLs are temporary; link the project page

my_role.resume: Not stated as a title; bullets describe building the prototype and its rendering systems
my_role.drive_chalo_gdd: Lead Dev: Systems, Networking, Architecture, Core Logic, Physics, Optimization. Partner (Swarnima): Art, 3D Modeling (Blender), UI/UX, Content Creation, Basic Unity Implementation.

description_itch: A cozy stylized 3D travel simulator inspired by late-night trip plans, long drives, beautiful landscapes, and the feeling of exploring the world with friends.

"Chalo Yaar!" is a cozy first-person travel experience where you explore peaceful environments, drive your campervan across beautiful landscapes, capture moments through photography, and simply enjoy the atmosphere of the journey.

The game was inspired by a very relatable feeling: that one late-night conversation where everyone suddenly decides, "Chal yaar, Goa chalte hain." Plans get made. Everyone gets excited. And then life happens. Schedules clash, budgets fail, parents say no, and the trip never happens.
This project was created to capture that feeling digitally — the freedom of the road, the calmness of travel, and the warmth of shared adventures.
This is not a fast-paced action game or a hardcore survival experience. "Chalo Yaar!" is designed to feel relaxing, immersive, and atmospheric.
technical_details_resume: First-person exploration, drivable campervan hub, wildlife photography progression, inventory and survival stat systems, on a modular multiplayer architecture using Netcode for GameObjects.
Custom HLSL rendering systems: procedural water shader with Worley Noise caustics, volumetric fog from 3D noise, GPU foliage wind simulation via vertex displacement.
Reduced draw call batches from 130,000+ to under 30,000 and raised sustained framerate from 15 fps to 50+ fps through shadow caster reduction, LOD tuning and volumetric fog masking foliage culling.
projects.design_doc_summary: GDD describes a cozy co-op road trip (up to four players, first-person) from Dehradun to Goa in a camper van, with van systems (fuel, health, stove gas, trash, lavatory, water), player needs (hunger, thirst, stamina, drowsiness), consumables, budget, photography and delivery jobs, day/night cycle, and a 25-week, 6-phase roadmap. Design intent, not a statement of shipped features.
projects.install: Download and extract the ZIP, run ChaloYaar.exe. Windows only; headphones recommended.
projects.closing_line: Pack your bags. Start the engine. Hit the road.

description_itch: SlenderAR is a Unity 3D horror experience that merges reality with nightmare. Step through a mysterious AR portal and find yourself lost in dark, ominous woods where the legendary Slenderman lurks in the shadows, always watching, always waiting.

Move by walking in the real world as your surroundings transform into a haunting forest filled with eerie sounds, flickering lights, and creeping dread. Experience the myth like never before — SlenderAR blurs the line between what's real and what's hunting you.
